name: ai-gateway
description: AI aggregation gateway for Cloudflare Workers: many APIs, keys, and models behind one stable endpoint — node-local cooldowns, tier fallback, circuit-breaker recovery.

scripts.test: node scripts/nodes-shard-test.mjs && node scripts/reliability-unit-test.mjs && node scripts/integration-test.mjs && node scripts/codex-contract-test.mjs && node scripts/claude-contract-test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:version && npm run check:deployment-config && npm run test && npm run security:scan
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run check:deploy
